name: Anqing Artificial Intelligence Computing Center start-up zone
developer: Anqing municipal AI computing center partners including iFlytek and China Mobile references
notes: Ministry of Science and Technology Anhui update says the 20P start-up area had started construction; Anhui News reported first-phase investment of RMB 30 million and planned 20P compute.

name: Anqing Cloud Valley cloud computing center
notes: People's Daily Anhui reported Anqing Cloud Valley formally opened on 2022-11-23 and provides cloud computing and data-center hosting services; MOST later described it as delivered and operational.

name: Yixiu District Intelligent Computing Center digital infrastructure project
developer: Yixiu District / China Mobile Group Design Institute design contractor
notes: Procurement award covers preliminary design for the Yixiu intelligent computing center digital infrastructure project; MOST reported all single buildings had topped out and expected mid-2024 operation.

name: Yuexi County Supercomputing Center / Big Data Industrial Park
notes: MOST reported Yuexi County Supercomputing Center buildings had topped out and were expected to go into use in mid-2024; People's Daily Overseas edition photo caption referenced the Yuexi big data industrial park project construction site.

name: Anqing Petrochemical information center data center
notes: Anqing Normal University IT office visit report says the petrochemical plant's two-floor information-center computer room includes a 400 sq m data center room, capacity for nearly 100 cabinets, built in 2013 and operating well with 48 cabinets in use.

name: Bengbu High-tech Zone Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Bengbu High-tech Smart City Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Weak secondary project-roundup source lists a Bengbu High-tech Zone intelligent computing center at the SME industrial park, invested by Bengbu High-tech Smart City Development Co.; needs primary-source confirmation.

name: Bengbu Mobile Cloud Computing Center
notes: Bengbu People's Congress research note on AI+ manufacturing says the city is coordinating computing-power projects and promoting the Bengbu Mobile cloud computing center; details on racks/capacity were not given.

name: Bozhou (Guoyang) Intelligent Computing Industrial Ecological Port
notes: Bozhou government says the Bozhou (Guoyang) intelligent computing ecological port is north Anhui's first commercial AI compute hub, total investment RMB 1 billion, planned scale 2000P, and has been built/put into operation.

name: Gujing Gongjiu Huawei digital-energy data center sample site
developer: Gujing Gongjiu and Huawei Digital Power
notes: Bozhou industry bureau reported Huawei and Gujing Gongjiu released a data-center sample site using Huawei smart micro-modules and UPS5000H to support Gujing Gongjiu's modern enterprise data center.

name: AsiaInfo Green Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Chizhou government reported successful signing of the AsiaInfo Green Intelligent Computing Center with total investment of RMB 1.2 billion, planned high-standard intelligent-computing center rooms and FP16 AI compute equipment.

name: China Unicom Chuzhou Intelligent Computing Center Phase I
notes: MOST Anhui update says Chuzhou was systematically advancing 11 computing infrastructure projects, with China Unicom intelligent computing center phase I at 500P listed as a key project.

name: China Telecom Chuzhou Intelligent Computing Center
notes: People's Daily Anhui reported Chuzhou guided China Telecom to build an intelligent computing center with 160P compute; MOST later said Chuzhou's built compute scale had reached 175P.

name: Hefei Advanced Computing Center 'Chaohu Mingyue'
developer: Hefei Advanced Computing Center / Sugon-related infrastructure
notes: Jiemian Anhui reports the Chaohu Mingyue advanced computing platform went into operation in June 2021 and supports Anhui meteorology, quantum communications, new display, and medical equipment workloads; People's Daily/USTC later describes it as part of Hefei's new-generation compute cluster.

name: China Telecom Anhui Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Jiemian Anhui reports China Telecom Anhui Intelligent Computing Center launched in Hefei in July 2022, with 16,000 high-density racks and supported compute scale up to 2.2 EFLOPS.

name: Zhongbei Hefei Low-carbon AI Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Zhongbei Communication / Hefei Shushan Economic and Technological Development Zone
notes: Xinhua Anhui reported Zhongbei Hefei Intelligent Computing Center officially went online in Shushan Economic and Technological Development Zone; earlier Xinhua Anhui item described the signed East China base project as a GPU intelligent computing center and battery production base.

name: Hefei City Cloud Data Center Co., Ltd. IDC services
developer: Hefei City Cloud Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Company-profile sources describe Hefei City Cloud's main businesses as cloud platforms/solutions plus IDC and value-added services; treated as an operating local IDC/service provider rather than a newly announced campus.

name: China Telecom Huaibei Big Data Center
notes: Huaibei Data Resources Bureau visit report says the China Telecom Huaibei data center can hold 1,200 IDC cabinets, carries the municipal government cloud and extranet core nodes, and has more than 22,000 cores of general and intelligent computing capacity.

name: China Telecom Huainan Shannan data center and communications production building
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported China Telecom broke ground in Huainan at the end of November 2024; project investment RMB 100 million, planned 1,000 racks, integrating Anhui Tianyi Cloud.

name: Huangshan 'Dawei' Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Huangshan Tourism Group and Beijing DataCanvas Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Huangshan government reported the project release in Tunxi on 2024-12-28; DataCanvas says the center was lit, has DeepSeek-R1 online, is backed by Huangshan Tourism Group and DataCanvas, and has an investment estimate of RMB 260 million.
